name: Run cost provenance on the PR list, the run timeline and the trace drawer
description:
Cost is rendered from three seeded agent_runs on PR #482 and one on #479, and the point of the flow is PROVENANCE, not just that a number appears: a provider-reported cost prints bare ('$0.041'), an estimated one prints with a leading tilde ('~$0.014'), and a run that failed before spending anything prints an em dash instead of '$0.00'. A formatter that dropped the tilde, or that coerced null to zero, would still satisfy a plain '$' assertion — these three forms together are what make the assertion meaningful.

The timeline badges cover the three terminal run states the seed provides: rejected (done + request_changes), reviewed (done + approved) and error (failed, carrying the OpenRouter message).

The trace drawer asserts only the fields that are derived arithmetically from the seeded run row — durationMs 8200 -> '8.2s' and tokensIn/Out 14820/1240 -> '15k->1.2k' -- plus the same provider cost. The drawer's grounding stat is deliberately NOT asserted here: it is denormalised into agent_runs.grounding and drifts from the review's real finding count on any database seeded before the widened fixture, which would make this flow fail for a reason that has nothing to do with cost.

Read-only seeded data (no model call).

land on the PR list

guard: the home redirect landed on the demo repo — the seed holds TWO repos (acme/payments-api and xvivs/dev-digest) and ReposRepository.listByWorkspace has no ORDER BY, so which one `/` redirects to is not guaranteed by contract
PR list data settles
the COST column header renders (headRow is uppercase)
PR #479 shows its run cost on the list
PR #482 shows the cost of its newest run, not the sum of all three

navigate to the PR detail route
PR detail data settles
switch to the Agent runs tab
findings tab is active in the URL
the run timeline renders

timeline badge: the older run approved
